info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Healthcare Appointments Cancel-v2-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointment Cancellation API allows users to efficiently cancel existing healthcare appointments. This endpoint is designed for healthcare providers and administrative staff who need to manage appointment schedules effectively. By utilizing this API, users can ensure that appointment slots are freed up and rescheduled as necessary, enhancing patient care and operational efficiency. Typical consumers include clinics, hospitals, and healthcare software platforms that require integration for appointment management.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a previously scheduled appointment. Ensure that the appointment ID is provided in the request to successfully cancel the appointment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an existing appointment. It requires the necessary information to identify the appointment that needs to be cancelled.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelReques.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling appointments. It is currently defined as a string type, which is expected to be a JSON formatted string.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.title: Cancel Appointment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the appointment cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the cancellation process.

state.description: The current state of the appointment after the cancellation attempt.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation process.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.description: Schema representing the response of a cancel appointment operation.

AuditInformation.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically.

AuditInformation.description: Schema containing information related to the audit of the cancellation process.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time, in milliseconds, required to handle the request.
